landing.title: Paid tasks, practical learning and your wallet, in one place.
landing.lead: Complete tasks that advertisers have paid for, learn new skills with courses and e-books, and manage your money in your own currency.
landing.featuresTitle: What you can do on Zentrix
landing.featuresLead: Every task shows its reward before you start, and every balance comes straight from our ledger.
landing.featureTasksText: YouTube, TikTok, ad viewing, trivia, Fix Tap micro-tasks and music streaming. Rewards come from the advertiser's prepaid budget.
landing.featureLearnText: Skills development, free e-books and forex classes. Education only, never financial advice.
landing.featureWalletText: Deposits and withdrawals in your own currency, with every fee shown before you confirm.
landing.featureInviteText: Share your referral link. Referral rewards are fixed, capped and only for people you invite directly.
landing.featureAdsText: Businesses fund campaigns that members complete, and see a clear spend report.
landing.featureSafetyText: Two-step verification, payouts only to your verified number, and every money movement recorded.
landing.howLead: Three steps, with the costs shown up front.
landing.step1Text: Choose your country, confirm your email and mobile number.
landing.step2Text: A one-time fee, shown before you pay, unlocks tasks and the learning library.
landing.step3Text: Rewards are credited after each task is checked. Withdraw to your verified mobile number.
landing.faq1A: No. What you earn depends on the funded tasks available and how many you complete. Zentrix never promises a fixed or typical income.
landing.faq2Q: What does the activation fee buy?
landing.faq2A: Access to task modules, the learning library and member support. It is a service fee, not an investment, and it is not paid to other members.
landing.faq3Q: Where do task rewards come from?
landing.faq3A: From budgets that advertisers and clients pay in advance. When a campaign's budget runs out, its tasks stop paying and the app says so.
landing.faq4Q: Can I change my phone number?
landing.faq4A: Payouts only go to your verified number, so only support can change it after checking your identity. Withdrawals then pause for 48 hours.
landing.ctaText: Zentrix is in its test stage. Accounts work, but no real money moves yet.

register.countryHint: This sets your wallet currency. It cannot be changed later.
register.phoneHint: Payouts only go to this number. After sign-up, only support can change it.

register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
register.referralHint: If someone invited you. It cannot be added or changed later.
register.pinNote: Zentrix will never ask for your mobile-money PIN.
